name: heavy idle breathing loop
rules: Side view facing right; the creature keeps exactly the same size and design in every cell; the stone shell plates are rigid.
The head lags one frame behind the body; the stubby tail moves on its own rhythm.
Heavy creature: very small bounce, slow wind-ups, long recoveries.

frames.pose: exhale: belly and back 1 pixel lower, hooves unchanged, the head still up
exhale hold: head now 1 pixel lower, a small breath at the snout, the tail flicked 1 pixel
inhale: body back up, the head still low
